question: What broader spiritual and human aims are declared to be rooted in Śakti?
premises: All austerity is said to be rooted in Śakti.
The four goals of human life are likewise included.
The statement is addressed to the beloved.
inference: All austerity and the four goals of life are rooted in Śakti.
plain_english: O beloved, all austerity is rooted in Śakti, and likewise the four goals of life.
